Further, as per the settlement deed, an amount of Rs. 2,72,000/-
has already been paid to respondent no.2 and the remaining amount of Rs. 1,50,500/- has been paid to her in court today, by cash.

7. Petitioners and complainant/respondent no. 2 are present before the Court and have been duly identified by their respective counsel, as well as the Investigating Officer, SI Kumher Singh, P.S. Pul Prahalad Pur.
8. The complainant/respondent No.2 states that the matter has been settled with the petitioners and she has no objection if the FIR is quashed.
She further states that all the terms of the agreement have been complied with.
